channel.title: Quickwell: tools, guides & books
channel.description: New Quickwell tools, practical guides and published books.

item.title: Antes de Firmar | Revisa contratos y cláusulas
item.description: Pega un contrato para detectar renovaciones, penalizaciones, retenciones, cambios de precio y otros riesgos antes de firmar. Nada se sube.

item.title: WorldSource Commodity Desk: precios de materias primas y mercados globales
item.description: Consulta precios de materias primas, divisas y rendimientos del Tesoro con fuentes oficiales, un resumen diario y seguimiento privado de posiciones.

item.title: Validador de Archivos GeoJSON EUDR | Quickwell
item.description: Valida archivos GeoJSON, KML, CSV y WKT para preparar declaraciones EUDR. Comprueba coordenadas, geometrías y parcelas; los archivos se procesan en tu navegador.

item.title: Fuelgauge | Analizador de Márgenes de Combustible
item.description: Analiza entregas y ventas de combustible por producto y ubicación. Revisa volúmenes, costos y márgenes brutos. Esta herramienta no calcula el consumo de vehículos en km/L o L/100 km.

item.title: Auditoría de Liquidación de Carga | Haul Audit
item.description: Compara la confirmación de tarifa, la liquidación del corredor y el depósito de factoring. Detecta diferencias y revisa cada concepto en tu navegador.

item.title: What Can I Make With What I Have? | Quickwell Dinner
item.description: Tap ingredients you have to get three dinner ideas for tonight, plus one thing to buy if needed. Works in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Double Dose: catch the same ingredient twice
item.description: Enter the active ingredients from your medicine labels; it flags when two products share one, so you don't double up. Not medical advice.

item.title: Where to Buy Commodities and How to Check a Licence
item.description: The kinds of licensed places that sell gold, oil, grain and other commodities, and how to check a dealer or broker licence with your regulator.

item.title: Copycat Kitchen: make the restaurant dish at home
item.description: Had something amazing out? Tell us what you saw and get a close home recipe — plus the trick restaurants use to taste like that. Nothing is uploaded.

item.title: WorldSource Commodity Desk: Prices, Brief and Tracker
item.description: Gold, oil, wheat, coffee, fertilizer and currency prices from official free sources, a daily brief, and a private holdings tracker in any currency.

item.title: Daily Commodity Brief: Oil, Metals, Grains, FX, Yields
item.description: A short daily brief on commodity prices: the biggest moves, Brent-WTI and gold/silver spreads, U.S. Treasury curve changes and the dollar. Facts, no tips.

item.title: Before You Sign: spot the traps in any contract
item.description: Paste any contract — lease, loan, gym, medical consent, freelance — and see the clauses that cost you. Runs in your browser; nothing you paste is uploaded.

item.title: Electric Bill Calculator & Rate Roll-Off | Bill Radar
item.description: Estimate your electricity energy charges, model a rate change and see when a fixed plan rolls off. Adjust every assumption privately in your browser.

item.title: Brain Pass: unlimited play in Echo, Swift and Linkr
item.description: One pass for all three Quickwell Play games: unlimited practice, every difficulty, extra modes, full stats and streak freezes. From $2.99 a month.

item.title: New Entrant Safety Audit Self-Check for New Carriers
item.description: Free self-check against the 16 violations that automatically fail an FMCSA new entrant safety audit. Optional $39 kit fills in your audit binder and files.

item.title: Printable: 16 New Entrant Audit Automatic-Fail Rules
item.description: Free one-page printable of the 16 violations that automatically fail an FMCSA new entrant safety audit (49 CFR 385.321(b)), with a check box for each.

item.title: Mediterranean Diet Recipes Book
item.description: Everyday Mediterranean meal blueprints built around simple pantry and fresh ingredients.

item.title: Plant Based Diet Recipes Book
item.description: Practical plant-based recipes designed for quick weeknight cooking.

item.title: Mastering Cryptocurrency Trading
item.description: A practical blueprint covering market structure, order types, technical indicators, and risk management for trading digital currencies.

item.title: Mindset Mastery
item.description: Actionable frameworks for building discipline, emotional control, and high-performance decision-making.
